media.title: Deanna Durbin — Cine Mundial cover portrait, February 1938
media.altText: Painted cover portrait of the singer Deanna Durbin by Jose M. Recoder, Cine Mundial, February 1938.
media.publicCaption: Deanna Durbin on the cover of Cine Mundial, February 1938 — a painted portrait by Jose M. Recoder, not a photograph. Durbin sang “My heart is singing” and “Someone to care for me”, written for her by Kaper and Jurmann for Three Smart Girls (1936).
media.publicCreditLine: Jose M. Recoder, Cine Mundial, February 1938, via the Internet Archive and Wikimedia Commons.
media.rightsNote: Public domain in the United States: published between 1931 and 1963 with the copyright not renewed, per the Wikimedia Commons file, which cites the issue and links the Internet Archive scan. The Commons template notes the work may remain protected where the rule of the shorter term is not applied to United States works.
